title: Paragraph-initial p and f gallows
statement: In paragraph text, the share of certain words beginning with EVA p or f is at least ten times greater for the first word of a paragraph than for words in line interiors, and exceeds the within-page permutation null.
source: The paragraph-initial gallows pattern is described on voynich.nu (Zandbergen); threshold set on the practice training pages (ZL ratio 69.4, Takahashi 63.9), not on evaluation pages.
